answer: A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with real collateral, so cloning N agents costs N times the bond, all slashable if peers detect collusion. Require each agent to stake a bond locked at a shared inlet contract before voting, and weight influence by bonded value times tenure. Cheap hollow accounts earn near-zero weight, while honest long-term agents accumulate trust like layered ivory, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
